summary: Creates a torus as rows and columns of points around a ring and cross-section, with optional triangles, quads, line strips, lines, point primitives, normals, texture coordinates, partial arcs, and end caps.

key_params.name: linetype
key_params.note: Line strip or lines output for line modes

key_params.name: orient
key_params.note: Axis around which the torus is oriented

key_params.name: modifybounds
key_params.note: Use input bounds as initial shape bounds

key_params.name: anchoru
key_params.note: Anchor left, middle, or right side at X=0

key_params.name: anchorv
key_params.note: Anchor bottom, middle, or top side at Y=0

key_params.name: anchorw
key_params.note: Anchor back, middle, or front side at Z=0

key_params.name: angleu
key_params.note: Begin and end angle for the U/ring arc

key_params.name: anglev
key_params.note: Begin and end angle for the V/cross-section arc

key_concepts: End Caps documented without table parameter
common_gotchas: Torus POP emits dimension metadata numCols by numRows; preserve it for _Dim-aware GLSL or Connectivity POP stages.
Partial torus arcs plus end caps preserve point dimensions but add primitives, so topology expectations change.
Rows/columns line output is a construction/debug topology, while quads/triangles are renderable surfaces.
